title: Nazi Zombie Outpost 2
author: Gbomb

scanner.why: no easter egg or ending found; default Round 20

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Description Nazi_zombie_outpost2 is the second version of the map outpost. There have been many upgrades to the original map. I would now consider this a large scale zombie map. A new outdoor playing area has been added to the map as well as a bunker. There is also a network of underground tunnels which connect different areas of the map. You need to open the blocker doors in a specific sequence to unlock the tunnel. You’ll need lots of points to last this long though so teamwork is a must. The previous maps glitches have all been corrected. Hope you like the changes and good luck!

notes: Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
